test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Match the following items with respect to money.

 
 

 **List I**
 **List II**
 
 

 i.
 Primary functions
 a.
 Distribution of national income
 
 

 ii.
 Secondary functions
 b.
 Measure of value
 
 

 iii.
 Evils of money
 c.
 Store of value
 
 

 iv.
 Contingent functions
 d.
 Instability of value

options.text: i - d, ii - c, iii - a, iv - b
i - a, ii - d, iii - b, iv - c
i - c, ii - b, iii - a, iv - d
i - b, ii - c, iii - d, iv - a

solution:
The correct answer is __**i - b, ii - c, iii - d, iv - a.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct option** is primary functions - **b**, secondary functions - **c**, evils of money - **d**, contingent functions - **a.**
 
• Money is an** essential elemen**t of our economy, and it performs several functions that are crucial for the **smooth functioning** of the economy.
 
• The primary function of money is to act as a** medium of exchange**, i.e., it facilitates the exchange of goods and services.
 
 
• Money also acts as a **measure of value**, i.e., it helps in determining the value of goods and services.
 
 
 
• The secondary functions of money include acting as a** store of value**, i.e., it helps in storing the wealth in the form of money.
 
 
• It also acts as a standard of **deferred payments**, i.e., it facilitates the payment of debts in the future.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **evils of money** include **instability of value**, i.e., the value of money keeps fluctuating due to various economic factors.

 
 
• Money can also create **inflation**, i.e., the rise in the general price level of goods and services.
 
 
 
• The contingent functions of money include acting as a means of **distribution of national income**, i.e., it helps in distributing the national income among various sections of the society.
 
 
• Money also acts as a source of **public revenue,** i.e., the government earns revenue by imposing taxes on various economic activities.
